_provenance.source: LodgeiT 'Hire Purchase Detailed' reports (edge.lodgeit.net.au org 1598 report hp/176; org 962 reports hp/252, hp/227), read from PDF images by Fable 2026-09-20; every figure below reproduced in Decimal with unrounded internal balances, display rounded half-up to cents
_provenance.status: [wire] anchors; solved rates are Fable-computed, not lender-stated
_provenance.version: v1.2 — identity sign corrected (was '+ final_residual', a Fable error caught via PR #47); supersedes edad8551…b316

semantics.in_arrears: row interest = opening balance x r, payment after
semantics.balloon: replaces the regular instalment on its row (Scania row 60); Term in header excludes the balloon row
semantics.row_date: month label = accrual period start month; FY = Jul-Jun
semantics.current_liabilities: gross of next 12 instalments after balance date
semantics.non_current_liabilities: gross of remaining instalments incl. balloon
semantics.unexpired_interest: interest column summed over the same rows as each split
semantics.identity: current_net + non_current_net = principal_balance − final_balance, to within 0.01 (one cent of summation rounding); no wider tolerance is permitted
semantics.contract_form: fact input: hire_purchase | chattel_mortgage | equipment_loan — changes GST/title treatment, not the amortisation
semantics.residual_rule: final balance must be 0.00 against the lender's total repayable; any residual from a rounded stated rate is reported as rate_precision_residual, never forced to zero silently and never carried

lender_contract.form: Equipment Loan & Goods Mortgage (NAB form N127-306 02/2020) — a chattel mortgage, not a hire purchase in legal form; same amortisation

fees.unrecovered_establishment_costs: 275.00 prorated on remaining months, payable on full early repayment
fees.economic_costs: payable on early termination, formula in Parts B–E (not in scan)

lender_contract.source: Contract_-_Scania.pdf pp.1–12, Part A only; Parts B–E not present

reconciliation.difference: 0.11 = LodgeiT final residual; lender defines interest = total repayable − loan amount and closes at 0.00
reconciliation.rule: lender figure is the anchor; the stated 3.84% is a display rounding of the rate that amortises exactly (≈3.8399894%)

negative_results.per_row_interest_rounding: does NOT reproduce: Scania total 32531.91 / final 0.06; Wacker total 1781.43 / final 0.03
